sources.architecture_source: artifacts/architecture/solution-architecture.md (Status: Approved). ARCH-016 (single shared login) is superseded for this story per DEC-004: ACRI-66 AC4/AC5 require two distinct per-persona credential sets (kitchen-manager, fb-manager), documented as a deliberate resolution, not a silent contradiction.
sources.backend_framework_assumption: SUPERSEDED - originally Node.js+Express+TypeScript (never scaffolded); corrected by explicit human direction ('do the backend using fastapi') to Python + FastAPI + SQLAlchemy/SQLite, recorded in workflow/decisions.md DEC-005 and actually scaffolded/implemented on that basis.
sources.session_mechanism_assumption: Opaque server-side session token (crypto-random, 256-bit) via httpOnly, sameSite=lax cookie, backed by a SQLite `sessions` table (passlib[bcrypt] for password hashing). Matches DEC-005. SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE is env-configurable, defaults false pending the still-open AWS/TLS topology decision.
sources.failed_login_alerting_assumption: 5 failed attempts for the same email within a 15-minute rolling window logs a structured WARN-level alert log entry; no lockout enforced in v1. Implemented and independently verified (boundary + window-expiry tests) at the unit-test and code-review stages.

known_issues: CR-001 (MINOR): timing side-channel between unknown-email vs wrong-password paths in verify_credentials; low risk at fixed 2-account POC scale.
SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE defaults false pending open AWS/TLS hosting decision.
No migration tool yet; schema via Base.metadata.create_all() at startup.
5 pre-existing frontend dev-tooling npm-audit vulnerabilities (vite/vitest/esbuild chain), unrelated to this story.
